title: Malicious code in signed-manifest-updater (PyPI)
description: The signed-manifest-updater package on PyPI (version 0.1.5) is part of a malicious campaign that delivers remote access trojans (RATs). It overrides the installation process to download and execute a remote script, which is malicious in intent. Although the analyzed code was benign at the time, the package is linked to a campaign known for infostealing malware.
